adoptionScope: Measured NBA defense development baseline for subsequent player-impact versions. Does not switch the product's existing game preset or recompute OVR.
summaryZh: v46 採作後續版本的防守開發基準，取代 v45 候選路線。四季的全體在場禁區命中率 MAE 都優於 v44 與 v45，限制區與其他油漆區的全體細區誤差也都優於 v45，並保留三分防守改善；三種位置的四季平均禁區誤差均下降。球隊得分 MAE 四季平均 2.3695 → 2.4021 分的暫時退步依使用者授權接受。這不是宣稱每位球員、每個細區都已準確，也不是遊戲預設或 OVR 已完成更新。

targetSeasonWembanyama.remainingIssue: Restricted-area make on/off is still too strong and other-paint make on/off too weak; these partly cancel in combined paint. Other-paint shot deterrence also remains too weak. Do not describe the fine-zone Wembanyama problem as fully solved.

selection.primary: Older-three-season whole-game cross-fitted source-minute-weighted player on-court paint FG% MAE
selection.tradeoff: Fine-zone shot NLL is slightly worse than v45; player aggregate and fine-zone FG% MAEs are better. Values at grid upper boundary are not a claim of global optimum.

unchangedMechanisms: v45 midrange and three make models
remainingWork: Calibrate team scoring after retaining the improved defense basis.
Refine other-paint deterrence and individual fine-zone attribution, with both subzones and the combined zone reported.
Independently measure total-attempt-rate deterrence; current source choice models primarily estimate relative shot mix.
Fine-zone foul and rebound geometry remain unimplemented.
Healthy-ability OVR remains separate; this round did not recompute its ranking.
scope: Four already-seen same-season reconstructions, not future prediction. Raw on/off is descriptive, not a causal individual defense target.
